description: This file handles AJAX requests related to device actions, such as setting bridge mode and IGMP snooping. It checks user session, processes POST parameters for device configuration, updates device settings via setStr(), and outputs JSON responses.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a device configuration parameter to a specific value.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a device configuration parameter.
